title: Potential-Field Action Representation for Reinforcement Learning in Contact-Rich Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model-free reinforcement learning can acquire contact-rich robotic manipulation skills through trial-and-error interaction, but it often requires the policy to learn both task strategy and low-level motion generation. In this setting, the action representation is critical because it determines how policy outputs are converted into robot motion, shaping both exploration and physical execution. Direct Cartesian command interfaces require the policy to generate motion at every decision step, coupling task-level adaptation with continuous low-level control and increasing the learning burden. We propose PA-RL, a reinforcement-learning framework that uses artificial potential fields as the action representation. Instead of commanding motion directly, the policy adapts the parameters of an energy-like potential field, which generates a state-dependent guidance direction executed through a Cartesian impedance controller. translated_title: 面向接触丰富操作的强化学习势场动作表示
translated_abstract: 无模型强化学习可以通过试错交互获得接触丰富的机器人操作技能，但通常需要策略同时学习任务策略和底层运动生成。在这种设定下，动作表示至关重要，因为它决定了策略输出如何转换为机器人运动，同时影响探索和物理执行。直接的笛卡尔命令接口要求策略在每个决策步骤都生成运动，将任务级适应与连续的底层控制耦合在一起，增加了学习负担。我们提出PA-RL，一个使用人工势场作为动作表示的强化学习框架。策略不直接命令运动，而是调整类能量势场的参数，该势场生成依赖于状态的引导方向，并通过笛卡尔阻抗控制器执行。我们在p……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出PA-RL强化学习框架，以人工势场作为动作表示，策略只需调整势场参数即可生成状态相关的引导方向并通过笛卡尔阻抗控制器执行，从而降低接触丰富操作任务的学习负担。
en_tdlr: PA-RL is a reinforcement learning framework that uses artificial potential fields as the action representation, where the policy adapts potential field parameters to generate state-dependent guidance directions executed via a Cartesian impedance controller, reducing the learning burden in contact-rich manipulation.
